preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^5) representing the number of test cases.
Input consists of exactly t test cases, each with two lines: first line is n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), second line is n space-separated integers (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 10**5 for line in [stdin.splitlines()[i] for i in range(1, 2 * t + 1, 2)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5).

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n for n, a in [(int(stdin.splitlines()[i]), list(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[i + 1].split()))) for i in range(1, 2 * t + 1, 2)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a in [list(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[i + 1].split())) for i in range(1, 2 * t + 1, 2)] for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the sequence satisfies 1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() == str(sum_of_weights(a)) for a, stdout in zip([list(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[i + 1].split())) for i in range(1, 2 * t + 1, 2)], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2 * t + 1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, stdout is the sum of weights of all subsegments of the input sequence a, where the weight of a subsegment is the number of unordered pairs (i, j) with i < j and a_i = a_j.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(sum_of_weights(a), int) for a in [list(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[i + 1].split())) for i in range(1, 2 * t + 1, 2)])
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer representing the sum of weights.
